description:
*** DEREK DORGAN AUCTIONEER BALLINCOLIG (021)4871777 (086)0483003  ***

No.37 Westbury Grove is located at the end of a cul de sac and over looks a large green area. It offers a perfect home for a first-time buyer or a great opportunity to an investor, as there is no rent cap and is in turnkey condition as it has been painted and new carpets fitted. This property offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout, and a BER rating reflects the quality of the property. It enjoys a superb location being within close proximity of Cork City, UCC, CUH and Wilton Shopping centre.
 
Accommodation consists of Lounge, dining room, Kitchen, Utility room and office on the ground floor. With Three bedrooms and the main bathroom on the first floor
